title: 4. Article 2 – Admission or Establishment of New States

blocks.content:
Article 2 empowers Parliament to:
• Admit new states into the Union, OR
• Establish new states.

EXAMPLE:
• Sikkim became a state of India in 1975.

EXAM FACT:
Article 2 deals with external reorganization (new states entering India).
Article 2 deals with external reorganization (new states entering India).

items: Article 2 specifically deals with external reorganization (admission/establishment of external territories), unlike Article 3 which covers internal reorganization.
Sikkim becoming a state in 1975 is a frequently asked example of Article 2 in competitive exams.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Article 2 empowers Parliament to admit existing states into the Union or establish new ones.
Sikkim became a state of India in 1975 under this constitutional provision.
This article exclusively governs external reorganization where new territories join India.
